description_ru: Двое друзей планируют сюрприз ко дню рождения Анны: место, еду, музыку и стулья. Полезные фразы для планов и сравнений.
text:
Mia: Tom, I have a big problem. Anna's birthday is on Saturday, and I have no plan.
Tom: Relax, Mia. She is turning thirty, so we need something special. What did she say she wanted?
Mia: She said she wanted a quiet evening. But I think that means she wants a surprise.
Tom: That is a strange rule, but you know her better than I do. Where are we going to have the party?
Mia: My flat is too small. There are only two chairs in the living room.
Tom: Then use my garden. It is bigger than your flat, and the weather forecast says it will be sunny.
Mia: Perfect. How are we going to get her there without telling her?
Tom: I have an idea. I will ask her to help me move a table on Saturday afternoon.
Mia: Will she believe that? You never move anything.
Tom: That is why it is a good story. She will laugh and come anyway.
Mia: OK. Now, food. I am going to make a big chocolate cake. It is her favourite.
Tom: Please do not use your grandmother's recipe again. Last time the cake was harder than a stone.
Mia: That was not my fault. The oven was too hot. This time I am going to buy a cake at the bakery.
Tom: That is much safer. And I will make sandwiches and a big salad.
Mia: Tom, you cannot cook. Last month you burned a boiled egg.
Tom: It was a small accident. Honestly, I have improved. I watched twelve videos on the internet.
Mia: Fine. But I will check the sandwiches before anyone eats them.
Tom: Deal. How many people are coming?
Mia: I invited twenty-two. Seventeen said yes, and three did not answer.
Tom: Who are the three?
Mia: Her cousin Peter, her old teacher and the man from the bookshop.
Tom: The man from the bookshop? Why did you invite him?
Mia: Because Anna talks about him all the time. I think she likes him.
Tom: Mia, that is a dangerous idea. What if he brings his girlfriend?
Mia: Then we will smile and offer her a sandwich. Now, what about music?
Tom: I will bring my speaker and make a list of songs from the nineties.
Mia: Anna was born in the nineties, but she hates those songs.
Tom: Then I will choose songs from the last ten years. They are more modern, and everyone knows them.
Mia: Good. And decorations. I bought thirty balloons and a long banner.
Tom: What does the banner say?
Mia: It says "Happy Birthday, Anna!" in big gold letters. The shop assistant helped me choose the colour.
Tom: Gold is better than pink. Anna says that pink is for little children.
Mia: I know. By the way, I also bought a present. It is a small camera.
Tom: A camera? That is expensive. I only bought her a book.
Mia: Do not worry. We can write both our names on the card.
Tom: That is kind. Thank you. I will pay you half of the price.
Mia: Great. Now, let me check the list. Garden, cake, sandwiches, music, balloons, camera. What did I forget?
Tom: Chairs. Twenty people need more than two chairs.
Mia: You are right. Can your neighbour lend us some?
Tom: Mr Evans has fifteen folding chairs in his garage. I will ask him tomorrow.
Mia: Excellent. And please tell him it is a secret.
Tom: He talks a lot, so I will say it is a business meeting.
Mia: A business meeting with balloons? Nobody will believe you.
Tom: Then I will say it is a very strange meeting.
Mia: OK. Let us meet again on Friday and prepare everything. What time is good for you?
Tom: After work, at six o'clock. I will bring pizza.
Mia: Wonderful. Oh no, wait. I just got a message from Anna.
Tom: What does she say?
Mia: She says, "Tom asked me to help him move a table on Saturday. Is it true?"
Tom: What? How does she know already?
Mia: I do not know. Maybe you told her yesterday and forgot.
Tom: Oh. I think I did mention it at lunch. I am sorry.
Mia: It is not a problem. Please answer her right now.
Tom: What should I say?
Mia: Say that the table is very heavy and you need her strong arms.
Tom: She will love that. I will write it at once.
Mia: Good. Now we really must hurry. Saturday is only three days away.
Tom: I will stay calm. This party will be the best she ever had.
Mia: I hope so. Last year her party was a disaster, and it rained all day.
Tom: This year we have a garden, gold balloons and chairs from Mr Evans. What could go wrong?
Mia: Please do not say that. Every time you say it, something goes wrong.
Tom: You are too serious. Come on, give me the list. I will take care of the music.
Mia: Fine. And I will take care of the food, apart from the sandwiches.
Tom: You are very funny today. Do you want a coffee?
Mia: Yes, please. A large one, with extra sugar.
Tom: Of course. A planner like you needs energy.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Задняя часть языка касается мягкого нёба, звук идёт через нос; не добавляйте отчётливого «г» в конце.
Долгий звук «у» с округлёнными губами; не делайте его коротким и не добавляйте «ю».
Кончик языка слегка между зубами, воздух проходит без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».

questions.question: Where will they have the party?
What will Mia buy instead of making a cake?
What problem did Tom create?
questions.answer: He told Anna about moving a table, so she asked about it.
